items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment and admit no new CRO, prototype, telemetry, spend, or duplicate queue work while delivery remains saturated at 10/10 slots and measurement remains open. After CTO releases one slot by completing or closing the existing saveusfarms.com repair case, execute only canonical request 4719e525-763b-42a4-9f16-e71e1c38b17b for allthingsmasonic.com. Baseline: 61 registered affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Test CTA hierarchy, adjacent disclosure placement, accessibility, and responsive layout while preserving destinations and identifiers. Measure registered affiliate clicks and available conversions for 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks; report delta or inconclusive result without causal or revenue claims. Roll back the single bounded diff if validation fails or accessibility regresses.

GitHub signals remain deferred research opportunities, not adoption recommendations. microsoft/markitdown (MIT; lab supported fit, 8/8 bounded checks), shadcn-ui/ui (MIT; 3/3 bounded checks), and mermaid-js/mermaid (MIT; supported fit but no native checks) have plausible fleet uses. Evidence is insufficient on dependency exposure, maintenance burden, runtime fit, security, and conversion impact; no dependencies were installed and no production access occurred. If capacity later permits, the smallest reversible prototypes are: convert a fixed sample of existing source files to draft Markdown and compare editorial QA/time-to-publish; render one isolated accessible CTA component against an existing page fixture and run visual/accessibility checks; and render one static explanatory diagram for a high-intent guide. Expected learning metrics are editorial acceptance/time saved, deterministic accessibility/build pass rate, and engagement or search performance respectively, with a 1-cycle learning target. No prototype should be admitted before capacity and measurement gates clear.

Revenue attribution remains uncertain: the available Amazon window is 2026-09-21, with $4.92 aggregate commission under an unattributed provider row. Do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift. Preserve existing affiliate prerequisites and repair work; do not add monetization claims or new revenue experiments this cycle.
